concerns.text: Task T004 implements the AIPW estimator but its verification only checks bias (<0.01). FR‑007 requires calculation of 95 % confidence intervals and empirical coverage; the task does not verify that coverage is computed or correct, thus weakening FR‑007.
Task T008 aggregates bias metrics but its verification does not assess the empirical coverage probability required by SC‑003. Consequently SC‑003 is not exercised, violating the spec.

Task T009 runs a meta‑regression and verifies only a null‑interaction case (p > 0.05). SC‑002 expects detection of a statistically significant interaction (p < 0.05) when present; the verification does not cover this, leaving the success criterion untested.

The constitution (III Data Hygiene) mandates that every dataset file be checksummed and the checksum recorded in the project state. No task creates or records SHA‑256 checksums for generated data files, breaching the constitution.
Versioning Discipline (IV) requires updating the `state/...yaml` artifact‑hash map after new files are produced. No task updates this map, violating the constitution.
Task T007 streams results to parquet files but does not record checksums for those files nor update the state artifact map, further breaching Data Hygiene and Versioning Discipline.
